reelection.rule: Rule: end of the current class term in legislators-current.yaml. Class 2 ends 2027-01-03. The November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file does not store the election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 Senate votes, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 1. Of 39 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 38 (97%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 44 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

finance.scope_note: Figures are committee receipts and itemized Schedule A for this two-year cycle only. This is not career fundraising. Schedule E outside spending is not included.

bills.title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of November 15, 2026, as "National Warrior Call Day" and recognizing the importance of connecting members of the Armed Forces and veterans in the United States to support structures necessary to transition from the battlefield, especially peer-to-peer connection.

A resolution designating October 7, 2026, as "Energy Efficiency Day" in celebration of the economic and environmental benefits that have been driven by private sector innovation and Federal energy efficiency policies.
A resolution designating the week of October 4, 2026, through October 10, 2026, as "National Community Policing Week".

A resolution acknowledging that it is in the national interest of the United States to support democratic actors in the Russian Federation, commending the work of Russian civil society and independent media to expose and respond to the crimes of the government of Vladimir Putin and pursue accountability for such crimes.

sponsored.note: Up to five recent sponsored bills from Congress.gov, latest introduced date first. This is not a full list of sponsored legislation.

lobbying_summary.line: Lobbying filings mention 0 of the 5 listed bills checked.
lobbying_summary.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.

running.label: Candidates who filed with the FEC for this seat. Filing is not the same as being on the ballot. Primary results and ballot access are not shown.
running.year_rule: Senate filings use the two-year cycle of the next election. the current term ends 2027-01-03, so the preceding November election is 2026.
incumbent_notes: Jeanne Shaheen has a 2026 filing for this seat (FEC S0NH00219, FEC lists: Incumbent), but the FEC marks that candidate inactive. Not counted below.

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.
donor_industry.cycle_rule: Senate filings use the two-year cycle of the next election. the current term ends 2027-01-03, so the preceding November election is 2026.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: Senate votes 1–262 of the 119th Congress, session 2 (262 votes, January 5, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the Senate LIS.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.
stands_for.factual_flag: Not yet summarized: this line is built only from the official vote question and the bill's official title.

party_line.scope: Senate votes 1–262 of the 119th Congress, session 2 (262 votes, January 5, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the Senate LIS.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
As our Commander-in-Chief attempts to fuel Putin’s war machine in Ukraine, his diesel "deal" is coming apart at the seams.

Congress has made clear: Russian diesel won’t lower prices for Americans and it has no place in our country⬇️ https://t.co/6s91DtIqTZ

Even @POTUS' own former chief economic advisor admits that tariffs are driving up costs.

Granite Staters are already struggling with high prices, yet this Administration continues to double down on policies that make everyday necessities more expensive.
https://t.co/JBr1Llcefk

Every student deserves access to a quality education and the opportunity to succeed.

During American Education Week, we recognize the dedicated teachers, school staff and education professionals who work tirelessly to support students across New Hampshire and the country.

Five years ago, I was proud to help negotiate and pass the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to deliver historic investments in New Hampshire’s roads and bridges and water and broadband infrastructure.
 
Today, we continue to see the benefits of these investments in our communities.

With prices rising across the board, Americans shouldn’t also have to shoulder the exorbitant cost of life-saving insulin.

On World Diabetes Day, I’m calling for the Senate to pass my bipartisan INSULIN Act to cap monthly out-of-pocket insulin costs at $35.
This Native American Heritage Month, we honor the cultures and contributions of indigenous communities in New Hampshire and across the country.

America has lost 23 service members to the war in Iran, including several in the past five months.

For the President to claim otherwise is an outrageous insult to their service and sacrifice. The American people deserve better from their Commander in Chief. https://t.co/a9dXgCCCWW

I have seen firsthand the remarkable spirit that defines the North Country, and I'm proud to have helped leaders across the region make an impact.

It has been an honor to serve the North Country. I can’t say thank you enough to all the incredible partners over the years. https://t.co/3P62IixIG7

All Americans deserve a fair shot at homeownership, but it is increasingly out of reach for far too many.

President Trump should spend less time on his gilded ballroom and more time working on solutions to ease our nation’s housing affordability crisis.
https://t.co/nxJBO0rGa4

In the richest nation on Earth, no American should have to choose between affording groceries or the insulin they need to survive.

By capping monthly insulin costs at $35, my bipartisan bill would help more Americans pay for their medication. 

Let's get it done.
https://t.co/hfVPJsYLIm

No veteran should ever feel alone or stigmatized while struggling with their mental health.

I’m glad my Senate colleagues unanimously passed my bipartisan resolution to designate November 15 as Warrior Call Days so that we can help connect veterans with resources and care.

On Veterans Day, we honor the brave Americans who have served our nation in uniform.

To all veterans and their families, thank you for your unwavering courage, service and sacrifice. We are forever grateful for your dedication to protecting our freedoms.

Happy 251st Birthday to the United States Marine Corps!

Today we honor the brave Marines who have answered the call to defend our nation. Thank you for your service and sacrifice.

My full statement⬇️
https://t.co/sNlCyf3iPe

That said, I voted to advance the bill to initiate a rigorous debate and amendment process to address concerns that I have about provisions that could weaken longstanding protections Granite Staters care deeply about. (2/2)

Americans have made clear that they want Congress to take action to address the soaring cost of living. 

The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act represents an important step we can take right now to do that. (1/2)

Inflation again rises under President Trump, making it even clearer why the American people voted for change.

There is no higher priority for congressional Democrats than affordability, and I'm confident they will deliver real solutions in the new year. https://t.co/uaA8TsEQ1h

It was such an honor to receive the New England Council's Legacy Award alongside so many of our region's business and community leaders.

Thank you @NECouncil for this recognition and congratulations to all my fellow award recipients! https://t.co/bwfaKINKro
Wishing a bright and joyful Diwali to everyone around the world celebrating the Festival of Lights today!

No American with diabetes should have to worry about affording the insulin they need to survive.

That’s why I won’t stop working to pass my bipartisan INSULIN Act to cap monthly insulin costs at $35 and ensure more Americans can access this medication.

Thank you to all the volunteers, poll workers and election administrators who began working long before Election Day to ensure New Hampshire's elections were safe and accessible from start to finish. (3/3)

Now that the voters have spoken and chosen their federal delegation, each and every elected person has a responsibility to uphold their constitutional duty and work together in Washington on behalf of Granite Staters. (2/3)

The right to choose our representatives in Congress is one of the cornerstones of American democracy.
 
Today, voters across New Hampshire participated in a free and fair election where they made their voices heard. (1/3)

Nothing better than getting out and voting in our great state of New Hampshire!

With polls open for several more hours, I hope everyone makes their voice heard at the ballot box today.

Let's VOTE New Hampshire! https://t.co/1SMRLS5ZuQ

🚨Granite Staters, Election Day is here! 

Make sure you get out and vote. You can find your polling location and voter information below⬇️
https://t.co/oof7BWmnDl
To all those celebrating Día de los Muertos, I wish you and your families a meaningful remembrance of the loved ones who are no longer with us.
https://t.co/oof7BWlPNN

Election Day is tomorrow!

Don't forget to vote and make your voices heard.

Find your local polling place and what you need to bring with you to vote at the link below⬇️ https://t.co/UYWF43Ygp4

Billy and I are keeping Senator Murphy and his family in our thoughts today.

We wish @ChrisMurphyCT a healthy and speedy recovery.

New Hampshire, Daylight Savings Time ends overnight.

Please remember to set your clocks back one hour!

Happy Halloween, New Hampshire!

Wishing everyone a fun and safe Halloween🎃

I'm so proud to have received the Legacy Award from the @NECouncil last night alongside fellow Granite Stater @KenBurns.

Thank you to the New England Council for this recognition. It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve New Hampshire and the entire region. https://t.co/vC64zkZBfr

Americans are paying the price for @POTUS's misguided decisions abroad.

Thanks to this Administration’s war in Iran, Americans will be forced to pay some of the highest airfares in a decade to visit their families during this holiday season. https://t.co/dnMwvwAsrs

Every mother deserves access to quality maternal health care, no matter where they live.

I’m glad to see nearly $120,000 going toward expanding prenatal and postpartum care and support for families in the most rural parts of New Hampshire.
https://t.co/UnVCbXLOSE

President Trump promised to lower costs for Americans. Instead, life has become more and more expensive for families.

Americans are falling further behind, and all the President cares about are vanity projects and price-raising, reckless trade wars.
https://t.co/RV1mebM8PX

Eight months into @POTUS’s war with Iran and no clear end in sight, more than $47 billion in taxpayer dollars have been spent—driving costs through the roof for American families.

The American people want an end to this war, but the President couldn't seem to care less. https://t.co/Zk8Sl4CUwu

Dolores Huerta dedicated her life to fighting for workers’ rights, equality and justice. Her legacy is a powerful reminder that we must never stop fighting for a more just future.
 
I'm keeping her family, friends and all those whose lives she impacted close in my thoughts.

On National First Responders Day, we recognize the brave firefighters, law enforcement officers and EMTs who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.

Please join me today in thanking first responders for all that they do.

The research being done at @UofNH's Jackson Estuarine Lab is critical to protecting NH's diverse ecosystems in and around the Seacoast.

I was proud to secure $3.8 million in federal funding to support the lab’s expansion and was glad to celebrate the newly upgraded facility. https://t.co/9RdcEuf5Or

🚨Granite Staters: Election Day is only one week away.

Have you made a plan to vote? Click the link below⬇️

https://t.co/n1NyghdpwD

🚨Granite Staters: Election Day is only one week away.

Have you made a plan to vote?
https://t.co/n1NyghdXmb

Every survivor of domestic and sexual violence deserves to be treated with dignity and justice.

It's been an honor to advocate for survivors and ensure organizations like @NHCADSV have the support they need.

Yesterday, I was humbled to receive their Lifetime Achievement Award. https://t.co/7reG7glsoN

Eight years ago, 11 worshippers were tragically killed in a hateful act of violence at the Tree of Life Synagogue in Pittsburgh.

Today, we honor their memories by standing with the Jewish community and reaffirming our commitment to combating antisemitism and hate in all forms.

topics.topic: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues

posts.text:
America’s leadership abroad has a direct impact on Granite Staters here at home.
 
It was great to join @USGLC and @WorldAffairsNH to discuss the challenges facing U.S. foreign policy and the importance of American leadership on the world stage. https://t.co/3Y46RMEmKo

No American should have to worry about affording the insulin they need to stay healthy.

My bipartisan INSULIN Act would cap insulin costs at $35 per month.

I’m going to keep fighting to make this life-saving medication more affordable.

Home heating oil costs more than $6.08 per gallon in New England—about 75% more than last year at this time—thanks to the President's war in Iran.

As temperatures cool, Granite Staters are struggling to afford their energy bills. That is unacceptable.
https://t.co/CrSmAqrU3A

It was great to meet with the staff, interns and volunteers at the Mount Washington Observatory who provide critical weather prediction services and research.

There’s no place like Mount Washington in the fall, and it’s always a fun trip on the Cog.

Thanks for having me! https://t.co/XyjVX23tv7

Every child in the Granite State deserves a healthy, safe and bright future.

As Red Ribbon Week begins, I’m committed to supporting prevention and education efforts that help protect our young people from substance misuse and strengthen our communities.

It was an honor to join Seacoast leaders and community stakeholders to discuss our progress in addressing PFAS contamination at Pease and the work that still remains.

I’m grateful for their tireless advocacy and partnership over the years. https://t.co/6F7avGXYaG

With midterm elections days away, the Supreme Court just made it harder for our Granite State students to vote.

I strongly disagree with this ruling and am troubled by any efforts to limit access at the ballot box. https://t.co/0WSCDHIFqn

American leadership abroad is critical to protecting our national security and strengthening our alliances.

It was great joining UNH’s 2026 Security Forum today to discuss the challenges facing our country and the importance of our next generation of foreign policy leaders. https://t.co/5E1iDNfwdE

On Monday, I met with @USDA officials and local stakeholders at Bartlett to discuss a path forward to keep this critical facility open.

While we made good progress on a plan, there remains more work to be done⬇️ https://t.co/XLScsM4N8a

Vladimir Putin is a war criminal. He is a murderous dictator who has killed thousands of Ukrainians in unspeakable acts of brutality.

These comments are disgusting and shameful. https://t.co/EKVhx2gj3G

Election Day is November 3!

Granite Staters, now is the time to make a plan to vote. Check your polling location now so you’re ready on Election Day. https://t.co/66qwW5vhLg

Since learning about the Trump Administration's efforts to shutter the Bartlett Experimental Forest, I’ve done all I can to protect this critical facility from closure.

While my meeting with @USDA officials was productive, there is more work to be done to protect Bartlett. https://t.co/f1K4A7vPDI

I was honored to receive the @NHHospitals' highest award this morning at their annual gathering.

With our state confronting Republican-led health care funding cuts and persistent workforce shortages, it is more critical than ever that we support our health care system. https://t.co/W9bQCD4i5b

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

Regular screenings and early detection can save lives. This month, let’s raise awareness, honor survivors and support every Granite Stater impacted by breast cancer.

It was an honor to join this morning’s James W. Foley Run in remembrance of Jim Foley. Jim’s courage continues to inspire us all, and receiving the James Foley Hero Award today was especially humbling—and a powerful reminder of his bravery.

Congrats to all of today's runners! https://t.co/0fXzG4ww5u
For more information, visit: https://t.co/GtEJzhGUTm

Election Day is just around the corner on November 3.

It’s time to make sure you’re prepared to cast your ballot. Check your voter registration, find your polling location and make a plan for Election Day. https://t.co/2uSavGk9tR

Too many Americans are struggling to afford the insulin they need to survive.

My bipartisan INSULIN Act would cap monthly insulin costs at $35 for Americans with private insurance. It’s time for Congress to take action to lower these costs.

It is an honor to be recognized by the @NHWomensFndn with the establishment of their new “Shaheen Girls Leadership Award."

While humbling, we must recognize the progress we’ve made, the work that remains and the importance of supporting our next generation of female leaders. https://t.co/nINS8Ar1tW

Donald Trump is using Ukraine as a scapegoat for the high energy prices American families are facing as a result of his war in Iran.

Make no mistake, America still stands with Ukraine. It’s Donald Trump who is shifting away from them. https://t.co/KVZO1GEdVF

As housing prices hit new highs in New Hampshire, many Granite Staters are forced to make impossible financial decisions.

We must continue to work to increase New Hampshire’s housing supply so that every family can find an affordable place to call home.
https://t.co/WtDx205geq

Soaring oil prices due to @POTUS’ Iran war are leading too many to fall behind on their home heating bills.

Families cannot afford another winter of high utility bills, but that’s exactly what they are facing because of this Administration’s actions.
https://t.co/SQ7uu4vRXw
The only way the war in Ukraine will end is if Putin gets serious about negotiating, and that’s not going to happen so long as he keeps playing President Trump like a fiddle. https://t.co/UlewQCtwYW

For 251 years, the U.S. Navy has played a crucial role in keeping Americans safe.

Today, we celebrate the brave women and men who have served and continue to serve our country. Happy Birthday, @USNavy!

As the weather gets colder, no Granite Stater should have to worry about being able to afford to keep their home warm this winter.

To help families pay for their utility bills, applications for home heating assistance are now open⬇️
https://t.co/oQJHsnQcj3

On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we celebrate the history, culture and contributions of Indigenous peoples in New Hampshire and across our country.

Today, and every day, we reaffirm our commitment to fighting for the rights and voices of Indigenous people.

Americans shouldn't have to pay more than $35 a month for the insulin they need to survive.

I’m continuing to push to get my bipartisan INSULIN Act across the finish line and lower costs for families. https://t.co/5TePUMctk8

New Hampshire’s small businesses deserve the resources they need to grow and thrive.

I’m proud to have helped secure over $2 million in Congressionally Directed Spending to expand access to advising, training and other key resources to power our Granite State business owners. https://t.co/6lzD1s1Ker

Live streaming an execution is an abhorrent act straight from the playbook of our adversaries, like Iran and the Taliban.

This spectacle has no place in our nation and should offend all Americans. Pete Hegseth is a stain on our nation and needs to go. https://t.co/GMIf5b92sC

No Granite Stater should ever face homelessness because of the Trump Administration's incompetence.

That's why I led our delegation in calling on @HUDgov to take action immediately to restore funding that housing organizations in our state rely on⬇️
https://t.co/0Iz6Ufak6m
https://t.co/GtEJzhGn3O

Granite Staters: Make sure you're prepared to vote this November.

There's nothing more fundamental to American democracy than making your voice heard at the ballot box.

To learn more about how to make a plan to vote, click below⬇️ https://t.co/rtUFqkYltd

The state you live in shouldn’t determine whether you can afford the insulin you need to live.

By capping monthly insulin costs at $35 a month, my INSULIN Act would ensure that's never the case.

With broad bipartisan support, the time is now to get my legislation passed. https://t.co/S5LekezdCG

Investing in energy efficiency is a commonsense way to lower costs for families, create jobs and help protect our environment.

I’m proud that the Senate once again passed my bipartisan resolution marking today as Energy Efficiency Day.
https://t.co/Gtj9f7cZNT

Today marks 10 years since my Survivors’ Bill of Rights Act was signed into law, establishing the first-ever federally codified rights for survivors of sexual assault.

I'll never stop fighting to ensure survivors are treated with the respect they deserve.
https://t.co/plQyreYK8m

Now is the time to put pressure on Vladimir Putin.

The Trump Administration must implement new sanctions on Russia to bring Putin to the negotiating table and end his war against Ukraine. https://t.co/jYcZQWPFDB

With affordable early education out of reach for too many, we should be strengthening Head Start.

Instead, the Trump Administration is weakening standards and jeopardizing services that have successfully served children and families for over 50 years.
https://t.co/rDXB16oY1f

During Mental Illness Awareness Week, we must continue to shed light on our nation’s mental health crisis and fight for more resources and better access to treatments so that all Americans can get the care they need.

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.
financial_disclosures.note: Senate financial disclosures are filed through efd.senate.gov, a different system from the House Clerk index used here. Senate filings are not listed yet.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
